exact_statement: For uniform Boolean equal-signed-mean children on a common nonempty stable essential mask, positive child full squared Fourier weights t0,t1, an occupied parent full atom and any fixed0<alpha<1, the actual paired same-alpha matching-empty full-spike fresh-minus-inherited KL is nonpositive iff t0=t1, in which case inherited and fresh references coincide atomwise. The same iff holds for either-sign normalized activation. All point-sign input-translation selector families g(a,z)=h(z XOR a*e1), r>=2, satisfy these hypotheses, including arbitrarily rare positive selector influence. If the interface instead allows adaptive weights and witness masks following the original coordinates, every complete source Q=bP+sum_j c_j delta_Wj with b>0 and occupied witnesses is hereditary under every finite Boolean coherent query tree: b_child=b/(2r_child), c_child=c_j K_child(Wj without queried coordinate)/r_child, both physical outcomes retained. There are zero fresh conversion charges, and the sum of all reached outcome/erasure KL plus full terminal inherited KL equals the original KL, bounded by log2(1/b_root). With source margin M0, complete terminal surplus S, prior conversion sum Sigma_old and old booking omega, remaining signed reserve is exactly min(S,M0-Sigma_old)-omega. Reserve>=rho iff both S and M0-Sigma_old are>=rho+omega. No arbitrary-core source-price or terminal-surplus theorem is inferred.
